anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet (display.kicad_sch), the BS0 strap pin (U4 pin 10) is wired into the same vertical node as BS1 (pin 11) that terminates at the VCC power symbol, while only BS2 (pin 12) drops to the GND symbol. The resulting strapping is BS0=VCC, BS1=VCC, BS2=GND (BS[2:0] = 0,1,1).
anomalies.expected: The specification states the intended I2C-mode strapping is BS0 (pin 10) → GND, BS1 (pin 11) → VCC, BS2 (pin 12) → GND, i.e. BS[2:0] = 0,1,0. BS0 must be tied to GND, not VCC.

evidence.quote: BS0 (pin 10) → GND; BS1 (pin 11) → VCC; BS2 (pin 12) → GND ... That BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping ... is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration
display.kicad_sch: U4 BS0 (10) and BS1 (11) share the vertical wire running up to the VCC arrow; BS2 (12) alone connects down to the GND symbol

anomalies.impact: With BS[2:0]=0,1,1 the SSD1306 leaves I2C mode and enters 3-wire SPI mode, so it will not acknowledge the DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA I2C bus driven by the MCU (PB13/PB14). The OLED display would not communicate, while the rest of the board is unaffected.
